pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Dark contiguous regions exhibit a star-burst geometry characterized by high-frequency, jagged edge gradients and deep inward projections of the light corridors. Patch shapes are non-uniform with sharp angularity.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: The negative-space network consists of thin, high-contrast cream-colored pathways. The topology is characterized by frequent multi-point junction nodes. A vertical diffuse occlusion artifact is present across the central longitudinal axis.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Visible along the superior margin as a low-amplitude, high-frequency serrated profile with a stiff, vertical-oriented pixel texture.

other_distinctive_markers: A prominent vertical, semi-transparent light-colored artifact (likely a dust cloud or lens flare) is overlaid on the central flank pixels.
